# Cipher-478 solution

## What the zip actually is

`puzzle.zip` contains:

- `data.txt` — a file of **NUL bytes**
- `next` — another archive (alternating **7z** and **zip**)

That pattern repeats **40,000 times**. The innermost archive only has `data.txt`.

Every `data.txt` is all zeros. The **payload is the file size**, treated as an ASCII code when it falls in the printable range.

## How to decode

Peel archives until there is no `next`. Record `len(data.txt)` at each layer (including the outermost one).

Keep sizes in `48..90` (`0`–`9`, `A`–`Z`). Drop everything else (padding sizes, mostly 200–400, plus 1000/2000/3000-ish decoys).
